title: Planning an industrial skid package procurement
summary: A clear battery-limits definition helps align scope, schedule and interfaces for modular packages.
body:
For packaged equipment, determine the battery limits before comparing bids. The equipment list, instrumentation, piping, control philosophy, utility connections and certification scope need a consistent basis.

Transport dimensions, lifting constraints and site assembly responsibility can also influence the package design and the delivered cost.
seoTitle: Modular Skid Procurement Checklist | Tongyang Process
seoDescription: Planning guidance for industrial skid packages, equipment interfaces and vendor responsibilities.
